text:
sam: Quick Q — anyone know if we have a saved logsearch for ap-sg -> zephyr route 5xx noise during canary? I'm seeing spikes in p95 and alerts firing a lot.

maria: Yep — there's an existing saved view but it's pretty generic. Try this query in LogSearch to narrow by model+route+region:

```
org:zephyr route:/v1/generate region:ap-sg status:[500 TO 599] | stats count() by status_code, model, route
```

That will show where the 5xx are concentrated. There's a saved view under Dashboards -> Saved Searches -> ops/zephyr/ap-sg-5xx (link: https://console.redwood.ai/logs/saved/ops/zephyr/ap-sg-5xx) but I recommend creating a rate-based view too.

devin: For alerts, what's the recommended threshold? current monitor is 3 alerts in 5m which is too noisy for high-traffic routes.

maria: Try switching alert to "rate per 1m" with a rolling 15m window and exclude known health-check paths. Example Datadog log monitor query: 

```
logs("service:inference AND route:/v1/generate AND env:prod AND status:[500 TO 599] AND -path:/health").rollup("count", 60).as_count() > 5
```

Recommendations: increase evaluation window to 15m, set notify_after: 15m to avoid flapping, and tag canary deployments so we can silence/mute during rollout. Also consider alerting on error rate normalized by requests-per-minute rather than absolute counts (errors/requests > 0.01 over 15m).

lena: I couldn't find the saved view path — can someone create a new saved search with the route+model filters and pin it to the team folder?

maria: Done. Created "ops/ap-sg-zephyr-5xx-rate" with the query above and a short description (includes model filter: model:zephyr-*). I added an example saved query snippet inside the saved view and attached the dashboard panel. ops-bot should have posted the creation event.

ops-bot: saved_view_created: ops/ap-sg-zephyr-5xx-rate by maria :white_check_mark:

ryan: Also added a dashboard panel for `5xx rate (per min)` that uses the saved search as the source: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/board/zephyr-ap-sg-5xx

sam: Nice — can you pin the saved view in #eng-sre and add to runbook? :thumbsup:

maria: Pinned in #eng-sre and added runbook link in the saved view description -> https://runbooks.redwood.ai/ops/zephyr-5xx-tuning

sam: thanks!
